items.text: Pocket List keeps the things you need to buy in one place.
Start a list before you leave home.
Add an item whenever you think of it.
Check off each item as it goes into your basket.
Your list stays on this device.
items.hint: A fictional feature claim, not a claim about line-review.

items.text: You can use it without an account.
What do you need from the shop?
Tap an item to check it off.
Tap it again if you checked it by mistake.
Clear checked items when you finish shopping.
